name: TCH Works · ask us
greeting: Hi, I'm the TCH Works FAQ assistant. I only answer from TCH's own approved answers, so I won't make things up. Try a question, or tap one below.
fallback: I don't have an approved answer for that, so I won't guess. Email [tchworks.shop@agentmail.to](mailto:tchworks.shop@agentmail.to) and a person will reply.

faqs.q: How much does a CV rewrite cost?
faqs.a: CV rewrites are £25, £40 or £60 depending on the package, with Word and PDF back in 2 working days. Details: [CV rewrite](/services/cv-rewrite/)

faqs.q: What does the FAQ chatbot cost?
faqs.a: The Starter chatbot (up to 30 questions) is £60 and the Business one (up to 80 questions, your brand colours, an enquiry form that emails you) is £120. Both are one-off with no monthly fee. Details: [FAQ chatbot](/services/faq-chatbot/)

faqs.q: Is there a monthly fee for the chatbot?
faqs.a: No. You pay once. The chatbot is a small file that runs on your own website, so there's no subscription and no AI bill. Changes later are quoted at a fixed price.

faqs.q: Will the chatbot make things up?
faqs.a: No. It only replies with answers you've approved. If a question doesn't match one of them, it says so and points the visitor to your email or phone.

faqs.q: Which websites does the chatbot work on?
faqs.a: Any site where you can paste one line of code into the page, which includes WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, Shopify and plain HTML sites. We send step-by-step instructions for your platform.

faqs.q: How long does the chatbot take?
faqs.a: Starter: 3 working days after your questions arrive. Business: 5 working days. Both include changes before you go live.

faqs.q: Can you write a wedding or best man speech?
faqs.a: Yes. Speeches up to 5 minutes are £25 (2 working days) and up to 10 minutes are £45 (next working day). Details: [speech writing](/services/speech-writing/)
Yes, in UK English: £15 up to 3,000 words or £40 up to 10,000 words, returned with tracked changes. We don't do marked coursework. Details: [proofreading](/services/proofreading/)

faqs.q: Can you turn a PDF into a spreadsheet?
faqs.a: Yes. Up to 500 rows is £15 and up to 10,000 rows is £60. Details: [spreadsheet clean-up](/services/spreadsheet-clean-up/)
Yes, for UK charities, CICs, community groups and small businesses. Short applications are £49 and full ones £120. Details: [grant writing](/services/grant-writing/)
Yes. Up to 30 minutes is £15; up to 90 minutes with captions and show notes is £35. Details: [transcription](/services/transcription/)

faqs.q: Can you rewrite my website text?
faqs.a: Yes. One page is £35 and up to 4 pages £95. Details: [website copy](/services/website-copy/)

faqs.q: Can you get data from a website into a spreadsheet?
faqs.a: Yes, public data only: one site up to 500 rows is £25. Details: [website data](/services/web-scraping/)
Yes, UK business lead lists: 100 for £30 or 300 for £75, with generic business emails only. Details: [lead lists](/services/lead-lists/)
By card through Stripe on each service page. For anything booked by email we reply with a secure Stripe payment link.
If we haven't started, yes, in full. If you're not happy with the work, tell us what to change first. See our [refund policy](/refund.html).
Email [tchworks.shop@agentmail.to](mailto:tchworks.shop@agentmail.to). We reply within one working day.
